title: ieee80211: Mark TPC Report link margin as reserved in certain frames
description:
In accordance with IEEE Std 802.11-2012 and later, mark the TPC
Report link margin field as reserved in Beacon and Probe Response
frames.

Fix a few spellings. Add dBm units as appropriate to a few of
the tagged fields (most the corresponding fixed fields for the same
elements already have them.)

Fix #19751

notes.body:
added 6 commits
  • 344bd689...8c473a49 - 5 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • fee2eef9 - ieee80211: Mark TPC Report link margin as reserved in certain frames
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15231/diffs?diff_id=980804745&start_sha=344bd689cafc874f1e32de05e8c6b00537a343ff)

Hmm, maybe? It does seem like that key is only used within that dissector, and it's set in `dissect_ieee80211_mgt` and only used in functions later in the same chain of functions called called by that function. I.e., it looks like it's mostly a way of avoiding have to pass the frame type or FCF as a parameter to all the functions. I think that `p_add_proto_data` is called every time it's dissected and used.
